reviews.title: Push Hard, Dont be too soft, they need to go all the way in depending on your motherboard ofcourse.
reviews.comment:
Works properly, everything as advertised, just make sure they are all the way in, as long as you dont bend your motherboard dimm pins, you will be fine, modern rams arent that fragile. depending on your motherboard you might have to press hard, which in my case was really hard to push them all the way in.
Also your first boot will take a little extra time be patien, and once you click expo profile it will train the ram and take longer to boot, don't freakout you will be okay.
